mapper.select: SELECT s.*, c.name AS collection_name, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM api_test_cases tc WHERE tc.enabled = 1 AND (s.collection_id IS NULL OR tc.collection_id = s.collection_id) AND (s.project IS NULL OR tc.project = s.project)) AS case_count FROM api_test_schedules s LEFT JOIN api_test_collections c ON c.id = s.collection_id ORDER BY s.enabled DESC, s.next_run_at ASC, s.name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_test_schedules (id, name, cron, collection_id, project, environment, enabled, next_run_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{cron}, #{collectionId}, #{project}, #{environment}, #{enabled}, #{nextRunAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE api_test_schedules SET name = #{name}, cron = #{cron}, collection_id = #{collectionId}, project = #{project}, environment = #{environment}, enabled = #{enabled}, next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE api_test_schedules SET next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, last_run_at = #{lastRunAt}, last_run_id = #{lastRunId}, last_status = #{lastStatus}, last_message = #{lastMessage}, recent_results = #{recentResults} WHERE id = #{id}
